text:
Asha: quick design check on the Error Sessions panel — specifically the filter chips row. want to tighten copy, keyboard nav, and export labeling before next release. screenshot in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xxx

Marco: saw the mock. main worry is chip wrap on small widths — when 3+ chips show, it pushes the timeline down and looks noisy. can we collapse into a single summary chip like ‘3 filters’ with a dropdown?

Samir: prefer keeping visible chips for quick toggle. if we collapse, ensure correlation id and request-id chips remain obvious (these are used in links/alerts). also: export should respect active chips (important for SRE workflows).

Jade: accessibility notes: chips need a semantic container and proper keyboard model. recommend `role=toolbar` or `role=listbox`? roving tabindex is best so arrow keys move between chips and Enter toggles. also announce changes with `aria-live="polite"` when filters update.

Marco: agreed on roving tabindex. current implementation has each chip as a separate tab stop — too many tabs. switch to single tab into the chip group, then arrows inside.

Luis: export copy question: is it "Export results" or "Export filtered results"? SREs often expect exact scope. I vote for explicit: "Export filtered results (CSV)" and put it under the kebab menu, but keep a small quick-export button when filters are non-empty.

Asha: sounds good. UX approach: visible chips up to 4, then a summary `+N` chip which opens a popover listing the rest (with checkboxes). keep correlation-id chips pinned to the front. export CTA text: "Export filtered results".

Jade: nit on copy for screen readers — the chip label should include the filter type and value, e.g. "Filter: correlation id equals 1234" so SR users know what it does. also ensure focus order inside the popover.

Samir: implementation detail: when user copies a trace link from chip menu, include the correlation id param `?corr=xxx` so it’s reproducible. Also backend should accept export requests with a `filters` payload — confirm API shape.

Marco: layout note — the `+N` chip needs a subtle focus ring and a hover tooltip "Show hidden filters". on mobile, the summary chip should be full-width and open a bottom-sheet.

design-bot: snapshot created for Figma frame "error-sessions/filter-row/a11y" (ver 4).

Asha: next steps: Marco to update mock with roving tabindex + `+N` chip behavior, Jade to add exact SR copy and aria hints, Samir to confirm export API accepts `filters` and `include_correlation=true`, Luis to finalize CTA placement (kebab vs inline). I'll collect comments and cut a small PR for copy. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

Samir: one more — can we add a short visual affordance on stacktraces when correlation id is present (small tag) so it's easier to scan in the request drilldown? low effort and high signal.

Asha: love that. add to the mock as a small inline tag next to timestamp.

Jade: also propose adding `aria-describedby` to the export modal explaining what will be exported (counts + active filters). helps SR users understand scope.

Marco: on it — I'll push an updated frame later today and ping here.

Asha: great — closing the loop after the updated mock. we should ship this as part of the next patch release (no major infra changes).
